# Johnson Village municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 12; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Village of Johnson, minutes of the annual village meeting, April 7, 2026: Will Jennison was elected trustee for a three-year term and BJ Putvain for a two-year term; the meeting seated trustees Ellis O'Hear, Ken Tourangeau, and Darrell Wescom as well

Village of Johnson (official website), Minutes & Agendas page: the Board of Trustees minutes of September 14, 2026 seat the same five trustees -- O'Hear, Jennison, Putvain, Tourangeau, and Wescom. Steven Hatfield, carried in some directories, retired at the April 1, 2025 annual meeting
Village of Johnson, minutes of the annual village meeting, April 7, 2026: Eric Osgood was re-elected Village President for a one-year term (Australian ballot, uncontested)
Village of Johnson (official website), Village Staff page: Rosemary Audibert is 'Clerk / Treasurer ... Clerk and Treasurer: 1993 - present'
Village of Johnson, 2024 Village Report, officers page: the Village Clerk is listed under APPOINTMENTS (Assistant Clerk & Treasurer: Susan Tinker)
Village of Johnson (official website), Village Staff page: Rosemary Audibert is 'Clerk / Treasurer ... Clerk and Treasurer: 1993 - present'
Village of Johnson, 2024 Village Report, officers page: the Village Treasurer is listed under APPOINTMENTS

Village of Johnson, 2024 Village Report, officers page: the village elects three auditors (one named holder, Bobbie Moulton to April 2025, and two seats already vacant); the April 7, 2026 annual meeting minutes record that 'no one was elected to the other positions,' so the post is created without memberships

Village of Johnson, 2024 Village Report, officers page: a Tax Collector office is carried (last named holder Rosemary Audibert, term shown expired April 2024); no current holder is published, so the post is created without a membership
